name.value: The Residences at Sun Peaks Grand

description.value: The Residences at Sun Peaks Grand are condo-style one- and two-bedroom suites in the heart of the European-style Sun Peaks village, operated by Sun Peaks Resort Corporation at the base of ski and mountain bike terrain. Units combine open-concept kitchens with full hotel services—including on-site restaurants, a heated outdoor pool, and three slopeside hot tubs—all 250 steps from the Sundance and Sunburst Express Chairlifts. The property is a practical mountain base for cyclists exploring Sun Peaks resort trails and the surrounding Thompson Highlands.
